claims.claim: FANNO-Dev achieves large-scale diverse data synthesis (153K+ samples)
claims.evidence: 153,351 cleaned samples from 211,093 raw (27.4% rejection rate)

claims.claim: Multi-pipeline synthesis produces near-orthogonal data
claims.evidence: Average cross-source cosine distance = 0.961; 7 of 8 sources occupy distinct embedding regions

claims.claim: Vendi Score enables quantitative diversity measurement
claims.evidence: Overall Vendi Score = 182.75 on 15K sample; per-source Vendi ranges from 66 (Code QA) to 170 (Document QA)

claims.claim: Diversity follows exponential saturation scaling law
claims.evidence: V(N) = 55.4(1-exp(-N/745))+109.0, R²=0.996, ceiling at 164.5 for single-turn data

claims.claim: Tag space utilization limits diversity ceiling
claims.evidence: Only 4.1% of domain×type×difficulty combinations utilized; Vendi saturates at ~5K samples

claims.claim: K-Center-Greedy is optimal for small subsets
claims.evidence: +33.3% Vendi improvement over random at N=500; advantage diminishes at N≥5000

claims.claim: Self-Inversion is a universal diversity amplifier
claims.evidence: Present in all 20 K-Means clusters; lowest isolation (0.224); highest within-source diversity (0.943); 0% same-angle rate

claims.claim: Self-Inversion has highest diversity density
claims.evidence: 32.4 Vendi/1K samples (12× more than Complex QA at 2.6); recommended 17.4% mixing ratio vs 3.2% natural

claims.claim: Self-Inversion produces genuine perspective shifts
claims.evidence: Mean cosine distance 0.458 between original and new angles; 82.6% > 0.3 threshold; 0% same angle; 5000 unique new angles

claims.claim: Multi-turn conversations maintain coherence across turns
claims.evidence: Adjacent turn similarity 0.575; natural Q-A alternating pattern; TTR stable at 0.84-0.85 across depths

claims.claim: Data quality passes comprehensive validation
claims.evidence: 100% JSON valid, 100% required fields, 0.01% refusal rate (14/125K), 0 encoding issues

claims.claim: No benchmark contamination
claims.evidence: 0 exact matches across 33K+ test instances (MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, ARC, HellaSwag); 416 MMLU false positives identified

claims.claim: Efficient pipelines are more diverse (negative correlation)
claims.evidence: Pearson r = -0.776 between rejection rate and Vendi Score

claims.claim: Self-Inversion is most cost-efficient pipeline
claims.evidence: Efficiency score 18.8, only 0.5% rejection rate; Pareto-optimal on cost-diversity frontier

claims.claim: Embedding space has high intrinsic dimensionality
claims.evidence: PCA requires 50+ components for 90% variance; PC1+PC2 explain only 9.2%

claims.claim: Code QA and Math QA occupy distinct semantic regions
claims.evidence: Code QA: 0.917 isolation, 0.677 centroid distance (most unique); Math QA: 0.891 isolation, 0.494 centroid distance

claims.claim: Creative Writing has lowest Q-A alignment by design
claims.evidence: Hit@1=31.8%, MRR=0.407, Mean Rank=60.4; creative outputs are intentionally diverse and not uniquely tied to prompts

claims.claim: Document QA has highest answer specificity
claims.evidence: Hit@1=97.0%, MRR=0.979; answers are highly specific to their questions

claims.claim: Difficulty level shows inverted-U diversity pattern
claims.evidence: Vendi: easy(35.8) < expert(102.1) < hard(128.4) < medium(143.1); medium difficulty maximizes diversity

claims.claim: Document QA has richest linguistic diversity
claims.evidence: #1 in composite diversity (0.921); highest exclusive vocabulary (32.7%); most unique bigrams (754K)

claims.claim: 20 latent topics discovered across 8 pipelines via NMF
claims.evidence: Code dominates 5 topics, Math 5 topics, Creative 1 pure topic; Self-Inversion has no dominant topic

claims.claim: Response structures differ significantly across pipelines
claims.evidence: Code QA: 100% code blocks; Creative: 91% multi-paragraph; Multi-Turn: 90% single paragraph; Doc QA: 73% numbered steps
